question: CPM ext window starts 1999-03-10 (~27y): which asset binds it; per-asset proxy + earliest reliable date; realistic extension floor + fidelity tradeoffs.
scope: read-only data-availability + proxy-feasibility assessment; no backtest run; writes research/ only; no prod/memo edits; no commit

ext_start.nature: convention anchor, NOT hard data limit

assets.longer_proxy: S&P 500 Quality idx backfill ~1994; AQR QMJ 1957; SPY crude
FTSE NAREIT All-Equity REIT TR 1972; Wilshire US REIT 1978

clean_etf_era.fidelity: full real opens; decisive inferential lens

faithful_floor.fidelity_cost: SPHQ index-not-fund; VNQ NAREIT index; DBC GSCI basket

stretched_floor.binding: EEM (MSCI EM 1987-12 non-investable) + SPHQ academic quality

infeasible.reason: no investable EM data before MSCI EM Dec 1987; EM is the wall

power_vs_fidelity.sanity_check: HAA-Simple ~52y in-sample Sharpe diff vs 60/40 = +0.246, 95% CI [-0.058,+0.540], does not clear zero
power_vs_fidelity.implication: sub-significance is class-level; 27y->32y (+18%) or ->38y (+40%) unlikely to flip significance
power_vs_fidelity.gain_type: descriptive regime coverage, not inferential power

recommendation: Reclaim ~11mo slack already available under current proxies (usable ~1998-04) if a slightly longer ext is desired; zero new proxy risk.
Optional faithful ~1994 floor (EEM<-VEIEX, VNQ<-NAREIT, SPHQ<-S&P Quality backfill) for descriptive regime coverage only; flag SPHQ/VNQ as index-backfilled.
Do NOT stretch below ~1994 for inference: synthetic EM/quality fidelity cost outweighs marginal power; even 52y fails 60/40 significance.
Keep clean 18y ETF-era window as the decisive lens.

confidence.per_asset_panel_starts: high (verified vs proxy CSV + fund inceptions)
confidence.longer_index_proxy_start_dates: medium (vendor base dates from domain knowledge; not re-fetched)
